https://docs.modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/en/model-studio/model-pricing.md: - Billing for file reads by URL : When a model reads a file through a URL, the transfer of the file itself does not consume tokens. However, after the file content is parsed, the parsed text is converted into input tokens and billed accordingly. The number of tokens consumed depends on the length of the parsed text, not the size of the original file. For large files, consider using knowledge base chunking and indexing to reduce token consumption instead of passing the full file content directly.
